verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an observability and alerting platform. However, the evidence pack contains no affirmative text showing that alert notifications can be routed to registrable outbound HTTP webhooks for automated remediation or agents. The Monitors and Incident Management entries are titles only, with no webhook content, and nothing else in the pack addresses outbound callbacks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point alert notifications at webhooks that trigger automated remediation or agents
